doc: Frozen instrument of I23 (historical inputs and M2 exit evaluation; BUILD_PLAN I23, whitepaper §8.7 source 4, §12.1, §15.2 M2 exit (a)). BUILD_PLAN names spec/M2/preregistration.json; a prereg commit may only add files under spec/M2/lib/ (holon/audit/prereg.py), hence the path. It fixes, before any I23 outcome exists: the two historical windows (the codec window, I59's whole window, for the header carrier's edges; the transitions window, from the block after the last Upgraded event to I59's window end, for the extracted rollup model), the deployed implementation and the pinned build it is compared with, the in-scope transactions and their input facts, the codec corpus, the M0 laws' premise inhabitants among the real headers, the supplementary acquisition (what I59 did not fetch, never what it did), the expected explained classes with their I16 mechanical criteria and a target of 0 unexplained, and the synthetic smoke corpus. Every value was computed from committed artifacts (I59's index.json and replay.json at f8fa447) and the I59 snapshot's own transaction and receipt objects; 'computation' says how. No model was run and no I23 outcome was computed.

criteria.extraction_defect: valid only with a linked fix commit and a green re-run record for that edge (links {fix_commit, rerun}: the rerun record lies under results/M2/refinement/, is for the same edge, lists the fix commit in fixes and has 0 disagreements; holon.refinement._extraction)
criteria.oracle_mismatch: valid only with a link to a failing hypothesis record (links {hypothesis}: results/M2/hypotheses.json holds it with status failed; holon.refinement._oracle)
criteria.real_defect: valid only with a link to a REFUTED law whose witness replays with obstruction_observed (links {law}: results/<M>/<law>.json is REFUTED with replay passed, the edge is in its cone, and replay/<M>/report.json observes the obstruction on every side; holon.refinement._real)
criteria.unexplained: anything else; the gate FAILS (GREF) and M2 exit (a) is not met

expected_classes.not_disagreements: cross-edge PAR differences on real inputs (one edge against another edge, e.g. enc_go_v1 against the chain's version-2 bytes, ok_sol against ok_go) are realizations of REFUTED laws, listed in laws.json, never refinement disagreements (BUILD_PLAN I16: O1 and O2 appear as cross-edge PAR differences linked to L_dom_hdr and L_par_hdr_v2)

storage_rule: The model's state is threaded through the whole trans window from one initial state: a slot's value before the replay first touches it is the chain's at trans.from_block - 1, never the chain's at the step's parent block. So a write the model misses, or a write by a transaction the replay does not step, surfaces as a difference at the slot's next touch (the pre comparison) or at the window's end (the final comparison). Compared: pre, the model's value before each step against the chain at b - 1 on every slot the step reads or writes; post, the model's value after the step against the chain at b on the same slots; final, the model's value after the last step against the chain at trans.to_block on every slot the replay touched. Residual: a chain write to a slot the model never touches in the window is not observed (no transaction trace is required).

blob_fallback.rule: the L2 blob-reconstruction fallback applies only to blobs whose I59 source is 'unavailable'

kinds.call: eth_call at b - 1 of every external call an in-scope step makes (callee, calldata, from = the proxy, the step's msg.value for the call): its success and return data, the answer the model receives
kinds.call_after: eth_call at b of every call item (same callee, calldata and from): a stability check of the answer, never an answer itself; a call whose answer at b differs from its answer at b - 1 is counted in trans.json call_stability
kinds.code: eth_getCode(implementation, to_block) and the proxy's EIP-1967 implementation slot at to_block
kinds.header: eth_getBlockByNumber(b) for every block holding an in-scope transaction: the step's block.* env
kinds.log_other: eth_getLogs of the proxy over the trans window, every topic outside the instrument's five
kinds.storage: eth_getStorageAt(proxy, slot, B) for every slot an in-scope step reads or writes, at B = b - 1 and B = b of that step, and at B = trans.from_block - 1 (the slot's initial value, read once) and B = trans.to_block (the final comparison) for every slot the replay touches
kinds.tx_other: a transaction a log_other item belongs to
